front.title: The 'imc' URI Scheme for Bundle Protocol Multicast

abstract.t: This document defines the 'imc' URI scheme, a concise integer-based scheme for identifying Bundle Protocol Version 7 (BPv7) endpoints that are not singleton endpoints, termed multicast endpoints. The structure of 'imc' URIs mirrors that of the 'ipn' URI scheme: each 'imc' URI comprises an Allocator Identifier, a Group Number, and a Service Number. In the same way that the Allocator Identifier and Node Number of an 'ipn' URI identify the node at which a service exists, the Allocator Identifier and Group Number of an 'imc' URI identify a group of nodes at which a service exists, and the Service Number identifies that service. This document specifies the textual syntax of 'imc' URIs, their interpretation when used as BPv7 Endpoint Identifiers, their CBOR encoding, and the corresponding EID Pattern, and requests the associated IANA registrations.
